> 第 13章 天堂山（第1页）
烈烈高阳之下，云层散去，狂风止息。
山崖上，一颗鹰人的头颅被姜尤抓在手上。
他转身看向被这一幕吓得战战兢兢的族人，笑道。
“族人们，你们还记得，鹰人王廷每十年一次的大征吗？”
“每一次征召，我们的父辈、祖辈，都鲜少回归，高蛮山部落便一直萎靡不振，几次险些遭遇灭族之险！”
这几句话一出，部落鹰人们的眼神渐渐从畏惧变成仇恨！
姜尤见激起了他们的斗志，心中点点头；接着说道。
“血亲之仇，九世尤可报！今日我斩其使者。将来，等我们强大了，便踏上天山，亲口问一问，那王座上的鹰人之王。部落之民，真的是蝼蚁吗？”
高亢的吼声震动了高蛮山，族人们的怒火被彻底点燃。
姜尤等族人们的吼声停下来，继续道。
“那么，从今天开始，我们便收拾行囊，迁徙去吧！”
“在那东方的海滨之地，有一座高大的山峰，资源丰富，环境优美，没人开发，正是我高蛮山部族的兴起之地！”
实际上，这个时候，斩杀了鹰人王廷的使者，所有的高蛮山鹰人便是一荣俱荣，一损俱损了。
高蛮山部落的一众鹰人便整理好了行装，跟着姜尤，往东方飞去！
天空上，看着下方木屋林立的村落，姜尤心中暗道。
经过长途跋涉，高蛮山鹰人部落终于在姜尤的带领下抵达东海海滨之山。
鹰人们发现，这里果然如同姜尤所说的风景秀美，资源丰富。
半空中，姜尤和族人们缓缓飞翔，身后，鹰人战士良突然高兴说道。

“尤，这座大山，以后便是我们的家了，你给它起个名字吧！”
他看着这座高大巍峨的大山，前世的那些名山大川在他的心中流淌过。
“此山雄伟壮观，堂堂皇皇，如同上天赐给我们的礼物，我其实想叫它天山的。但天山是鹰人王族的驻地，那便加一个字，叫做“天堂山”吧！”
鹰人们不理解天堂山意味着什么，唯有姜尤知道，他内心潜藏的无限野心！
在观察了一番后，姜尤带着众鹰人在靠近山崖的地方落下。
他们开始用早就准备好的青铜斧砍伐树木，建造木屋。
不到一个月，一个和曾经高蛮山部落的木屋村庄便出现在高山之上。
高蛮山部落便在东海之滨，开始了休养生息。
泰坦巨人和太古巨龙已经打成了狗脑子。
不止很多泰坦巨人和太古巨龙伤亡，费兰德万族之中，几乎所有的种族都伤亡惨重。
半神淌血，传奇陨落，整个世界一片昏天黑地。
高蛮山部落已经拥有了一千多人口。
遥远的西方森林中，传来一阵愤怒的大喊。
“阿苏娜！你真的要和我同归于尽吗！”

> Chapter 13 Heaven Mountain (Page 1)
Under the scorching sun, the clouds dispersed and the strong wind subsided.
On the cliff, Jiang You held the head of an eagle man in his hand.
He turned around and looked at the clansmen who were trembling with fear at this scene, and smiled.
"Tribesmen, do you still remember the great expedition held by the Eagle King's court every ten years?"
"Every time we are called upon, our fathers and ancestors rarely return, and the Gaoman Mountain tribe has been languishing, and has almost encountered the danger of annihilation several times!"
As soon as these words came out, the eyes of the tribal eagles gradually changed from fear to hatred!
Seeing that their fighting spirit was aroused, Jiang You nodded in his heart and continued.
"The revenge of blood relatives can be avenged in the ninth life! Today I will kill his messenger. In the future, when we become stronger, we will set foot on the Tianshan Mountains and ask for ourselves whether the King of Eagles on the throne and the people of the tribe are really ants?"
The high-pitched roar shook Gaoman Mountain, and the anger of the tribesmen was completely ignited.
Jiang You and other tribesmen stopped roaring and continued.
"Then, starting from today, let's pack our bags and move!"
"On the seaside in the east, there is a tall mountain with rich resources, beautiful environment, and no one has developed it. It is the place where my Gaoman Mountain tribe arose!"
In fact, at this time, by killing the envoy of the Eagle Man King's Court, all the Eagle Men in Gaoman Mountain were both prosperous and devastated.
The eagle men of the Gaoman Mountain Tribe packed up their gear and followed Jiang You to fly to the east!
In the sky, looking at the village with numerous wooden houses below, Jiang You thought to himself.
After a long journey, the Eagle Tribe of Gaoman Mountain finally arrived at the mountain on the coast of the East China Sea under the leadership of Jiang You.
The Ying people discovered that this place was indeed as beautiful and rich in resources as Jiang You said.
In mid-air, Jiang You and his clansmen were flying slowly, and behind them, the Yingman warrior Liang suddenly said happily.
"You, this mountain will be our home from now on. Give it a name!"
He looked at this tall and majestic mountain, and the famous mountains and rivers from his previous life flowed through his heart.
"This mountain is majestic and majestic, like a gift given to us by God. I actually want to call it Tianshan Mountain. But Tianshan Mountain is the residence of the Yingren royal family, so let's add another word and call it "Heaven Mountain"!"
The eagles don't understand what Heaven Mountain means. Only Jiang You knows the infinite ambition hidden in his heart!
After some observation, Jiang You led the eagles to land near the cliff.
They began to use the bronze axes they had prepared long ago to cut down trees and build wooden houses.
In less than a month, a wooden house village similar to that of the Gaoman Mountain Tribe appeared on the mountain.
The Gaoman Mountain tribe began to recuperate on the coast of the East China Sea.
The Titans and the Ancient Dragons have been beaten to a pulp.
Not only many Titan giants and ancient dragons suffered casualties, but almost all races in Flanders suffered heavy casualties.
Demigods bleed, legends fall, and the whole world is in darkness.
The Gaoman Mountain tribe already has a population of more than a thousand.
In the distant western forest, there was an angry shout.
"Azuna! Do you really want to die with me?"
